hero.subtitle: Open-source medical knowledge, plain-language clinical terms, and AI guidance — written and reviewed in your language, free for everyone.

purpose.title: What UltimateHealth Does
purpose.description: We build open health resources centered on body, mind, and dignity — ensuring reliable health information is never gated behind paywalls or language barriers.
purpose.moumitaQuote: Healthcare begins with seeing the whole human being — body, mind, and dignity. Dedicated to uncompromised medical care and genuine respect.
purpose.pillar1Body: 100+ community-reviewed health guides translated into 7+ regional languages, freely accessible without paywalls.
purpose.pillar2Body: Plain-language explanations for complex clinical terms, with instant search and inline reading tooltips across all articles.
purpose.pillar3Body: Voluntary doctors and our admin team review public health content and maintain clinical moderation standards on GitHub.

whatWeDo.title: What You Can Use Today
whatWeDo.description: Explore community health articles, look up terms in plain language, access voluntary doctor reviews, and use non-diagnostic AI triage.
whatWeDo.item1Desc: Community-reviewed health and wellness guides translated across 7+ languages, accessible to everyone without paywalls.
whatWeDo.item2Desc: Clear explanations for complex clinical terms, with instant search and in-line tooltips while reading articles.
whatWeDo.item3Desc: Ask everyday health and wellness questions for non-diagnostic guidance, self-care suggestions, and triage recommendations.
whatWeDo.item4Desc: Volunteering doctors review public health content and sign moderation protocols to help maintain medical accuracy.

storyboard.title: From Reading to Contributing
storyboard.description: Whether you are learning about a condition, reviewing clinical terms, or contributing code on GitHub — here is how the platform operates.
storyboard.step1Desc: Browse community health articles and clinical term definitions translated in your language.
storyboard.step2Desc: Ask the AI assistant non-diagnostic wellness questions and listen to educational podcasts.
storyboard.step3Desc: Suggest guide edits, translate medical terms, or contribute open-source code on GitHub.
storyboard.step4Desc: Pass verified health information forward to family, caregivers, and local community health workers.

portals.title: Choose Your Space
portals.description: Whether you are seeking reliable health advice, contributing clinical expertise, or building tools on GitHub — find your space below.
portals.portal1Desc: Browse community health articles, look up terms in the medical glossary, or ask general questions using the AI assistant.
portals.portal2Desc: An open invitation for doctors and medical trainees to volunteer, review community-submitted health content, and sign the Moderator Agreement.
portals.portal3Desc: Help build open-source health tools. Developers, translators, writers, and UI/UX designers are welcome to collaborate on GitHub.

glossary.title: A clearer way to explore health terms
glossary.description: Browse concise definitions, scan related concepts, and search by medical term, category, or keyword without opening an article first.

contribute.githubIssuesDesc: Find beginner-friendly issues or report bugs directly on our repository.

contribute.emailDesc: Contact maintainers directly for questions or partnership inquiries.

articles.description: Explore evidence-based health and wellness resources crafted by community contributors. From pulmonary wellness to mental resilience, discover insights to support your everyday well-being.
articles.memorialTitle: Separate Memorial Series · 30 Dedicated Clinical Articles
articles.memorialDesc: In honor of Dr. Moumita Debnath's clinical dedication and chest medicine training, a dedicated memorial series of 30 clinical research & respiratory guides will be released separately across all 9 languages. The articles listed below are our platform's general admin-reviewed community health library.

podcasts.title: Health Podcasts & Audio Stories
podcasts.description: Listen to community-recorded health conversations, wellness insights, and patient journeys. Web-based streaming is currently in development and launching soon.
podcasts.appBannerDesc: Recording, editing, and publishing health podcasts is exclusively supported through the UltimateHealth Android App studio. On the web platform, stream-only listening will be available.
podcasts.feature1Desc: Stream verified health discussions and audio wellness guides without subscriptions.
podcasts.feature2Desc: Episodes shared by medical trainees, patients, and health advocates.
podcasts.feature3Desc: Planned audio releases in English, Hindi, Bengali, and Indian regional languages.

apps.title: Explore the UltimateHealth Ecosystem
apps.subtitle: Different tools, one shared purpose: making health information easier to access, understand, and improve together.
apps.disclaimer: UltimateHealth applications are open-source educational resources. They do not provide clinical diagnosis or replace qualified professional healthcare consultations.

userApp.name: UltimateHealth Community App
userApp.desc: An accessible, open-source mobile companion for exploring evidence-based health guides, audio wellness podcasts, and plain-language medical terms without paywalls or ads.
userApp.feat1: Evidence-based health guides and symptom explainers formatted for comfortable mobile reading.
userApp.feat2: Multilingual audio narration and community health podcasts for hands-free listening.
userApp.feat3: Interactive medical glossary clarifying clinical terminology into plain everyday language.

adminApp.name: UltimateHealth Admin
adminApp.desc: A dedicated review workstation for certified medical moderators, resident doctors, and editorial volunteers to audit health content, verify citations, and protect clinical dignity before public indexing.
adminApp.feat1: Editorial review queue ensuring medical accuracy and non-commercial integrity.
adminApp.feat2: Terminology governance standardizing bilingual medical definitions and pronunciations.
adminApp.feat3: Clinical moderator agreement workflow adhering to patient dignity protocols.

webApp.name: UltimateHealth Web Platform
webApp.desc: Access the complete medical library, clinical series, and interactive glossary directly from any web browser across 9 languages.
webApp.feat1: Zero installation required — lightweight, fast, and optimized for low-bandwidth connections.
webApp.feat2: Complete reciprocal translation across 9 languages with native accessibility.
webApp.feat3: In-browser Web Speech audio narration and dark/light reading modes.

webPlatform.title: UltimateHealth Web Platform
webPlatform.desc: Access the complete medical library, clinical series, and interactive glossary directly from any web browser across 9 languages.

tribute.heroCoreMessage: A person's life must be remembered for what they contributed to the world, not only for the tragedy that ended or changed their life.
tribute.heroSubtitle: This is not a political campaign or a collection of incidents. It is a human-centred project about dreams, contributions, courage, lost possibilities, and what society must learn and build today.
tribute.startingPointBadge: The Starting Point of Our Tribute
tribute.startingPointMoumita1: Dr. Moumita Debnath was a postgraduate medical trainee in chest medicine in Kolkata. Her loss in August 2024 brought renewed attention to the safety of healthcare professionals and the dignity of people working in medical institutions.
tribute.startingPointMoumita2: This tribute remembers her as an individual whose life and professional aspirations deserved the opportunity to continue. Her story encourages us to examine how hospitals, institutions, and communities can create safer environments for healthcare workers.
tribute.startingPointCommitment: UltimateHealth honours her memory through responsible healthcare education, patient dignity, and awareness of workplace safety.
